verses.text: When you go to war against your enemies and see horses and chariots and an army bigger than yours, do not be afraid of them. The LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, is with you.
When you are about to go into battle, the priest must come forward and speak to the army.
He will say, "Listen, Israel. Today you are going into battle against your enemies. Do not lose heart! Do not be afraid or panic, and do not be terrified of them.
For the LORD your God is the one who goes with you. He will fight for you against your enemies and give you victory."
Then the officers must say to the army, "Has anyone built a new house and not yet dedicated it? He should go home, or he might die in battle and someone else will dedicate it.
Has anyone planted a vineyard and not yet enjoyed its fruit? He should go home, or he might die in battle and someone else will enjoy its fruit.
Is anyone engaged to a woman and not yet married her? He should go home, or he might die in battle and someone else will marry her."
Then the officers must add, "Is anyone afraid or losing courage? He should go home, so that his fellow soldiers will not lose courage too."
When the officers have finished speaking to the army, they must appoint commanders to lead it.
When you march up to attack a city, first offer its people peace.
If they accept and open their gates to you, all the people in it will become your forced workers and will serve you.
But if they refuse to make peace and fight against you, then surround the city and attack it.
When the LORD your God hands it over to you, kill all the men in it with the sword.
But you may take for yourselves the women, the children, the animals, and everything else in the city. You may use the goods taken from your enemies, which the LORD your God gives you.
This is how you must treat all the cities that are far away from you, the cities that do not belong to the nations near you.
But in the cities of the nations the LORD your God is giving you as your own, do not leave alive anything that breathes.
Destroy them completely: the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, as the LORD your God has commanded you.
Otherwise, they will teach you to follow all the hateful things they do for their gods, and you will sin against the LORD your God.

When you surround a city and attack it for a long time to capture it, do not destroy its trees by cutting them down with an axe. You can eat their fruit, so do not cut them down. Are the trees of the field people, that you should attack them?
But you may cut down trees that you know do not produce food. Use them to build siege works against the city that is at war with you, until it falls.
